meta.name: Love to Hate You
meta.description: For an attorney who despises losing to men and an A-list actor who distrusts women, love means nothing — until they're forced to date each other.

videos.title: Bad Girl
videos.overview: Yeo Mi-ran’s distaste for petty, philandering men grows even stronger. Nam Kang-ho offends his finicky co-star on the set of their drama.

videos.title: Bad Boy
videos.overview: Mi-ran starts a new job at a previously all-male law firm where she navigates awkward encounters with a top client, an ex-boyfriend and a familiar foe.

videos.title: Nice Guys Get a Pass Bad Boys Have It Coming
videos.overview: After catching Kang-ho in what seems like a compromising position, Mi-ran becomes determined to get close to him so she could bring him to justice.

videos.title: You Are Not What I Expected
videos.overview: While prepping for the role of his dreams, Kang-ho turns to martial arts enthusiast Mi-ran for help. Oh Se-na, an old flame, re-enters the picture.

videos.title: Love is Just an Experiment, Life is the Real Thing
videos.overview: Mi-ran bats away unwanted advances — including a tricky birthday surprise. Kang-ho's reputation is threatened when false dating rumors go public.

videos.title: Femme Fatale vs Homme Fatale
videos.overview: Mi-ran and Kang-ho begin a whirlwind — but fake — romance to combat questions surrounding the actor's sexuality. Do Won-jun meets Mi-ran's roommate.

videos.title: Trigonometry: The Love Triangle Edition
videos.overview: Feelings start to get a bit too real between Mi-ran and Kang-ho. Despite knowing Kang-ho's apparent relationship status, Oh Se-na tries to win him back.

videos.title: The Way You Change Me
videos.overview: When Mi-ran gets hurt, Kang-ho realizes his feelings for her are deeper than he imagined. Won-jun and Shin Na-eun flirt with teaming up — and each other.

videos.title: You Made Me Who I Am
videos.overview: Mi-ran and Kang-ho get serious and vulnerable with each other. To get over her crush on Won-jun, Na-eun tells him about her most embarrassing habits.

videos.title: A Passionate Goodbye
videos.overview: News of Mi-ran's dating history gets out, making her a social pariah. Will she and Kang-ho give in to pressure and break up, or will love prevail?
